message:
Let me check if there's a pre-built fuzzer binary in the build environment, and understand how the submit.sh evaluates the PoC.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'find / -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -name "valid" -o -name "xml" -o -name "*.a" \) 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | grep -v sys | head -20 && echo "=====" && ls /out 2>/dev/null; ls /work 2>/dev/null' 2>&1 | head -40</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
